values.note: Sites 1-16 full hookup, 17-20 electric only. Map pad lengths run 46 ft (sites 1-2) to 180 ft (sites 4-5).

values.note: Booking for the coming season opens in early January (8 a.m. on January 5 for 2026). Questions to the city office, 715-246-4268.

booking.source: City page ('Campsite reservations open at 8:00 a.m. on Monday, January 5.'; 'Hatfield Campground Reservation Link' -> richmond.rja.revize.com/app/bookable-groups/campground; 'please contact our office at (715) 246-4268')

note: City of New Richmond campground at 1321 Jerry Frey Dr, on the south shore of Hatfield Lake beside the highway 64/65 interchange, so traffic noise carries. Open sites with young trees; no campfires, two vehicles per site. --Claude
summary: City page 2026: $35/night ($900 monthly), 20 sites (1-16 W/S/50A, 17-20 electric), WiFi, dump, water, May 1-Oct 15, Revize booking. Lakeview kept (sites 14-16 15-20 m from Hatfield Lake but a brush fringe lines the shore). RecDesk link dead.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview kept, possible upgrade for the reviewer: sites 14, 15 and 16 (about 45.1376,-92.5350 / 45.1376,-92.5347 / 45.1376,-92.5344) sit 15-20 m from Hatfield Lake over mown grass, but a 5-10 m fringe of shrubs and small trees lines the shore in front of all three on Esri leaf-off imagery and on the city's 2024 drone map, so they do not have open ground to the water. Sold by the night like every site here. Sites 1-13 and 17-20 are 40-200 m back behind them.
